title: Jujutsu Kaisen
source: Jujutsu Kaisen manga by Gege Akutami (ended 2024), including Jujutsu Kaisen 0. Characters who die earlier end at their final arc.
world: In modern Japan, negative human emotions create Curses, invisible monsters that jujutsu sorcerers exorcise. Yuji Itadori swallows a finger of Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses, and joins Tokyo Jujutsu High under Satoru Gojo. The story escalates through the Shibuya Incident and the Culling Game to the final battle against Sukuna in Shinjuku. Stylish, brutal and often darkly funny.
power_system: Sorcerers channel cursed energy through innate cursed techniques. A Domain Expansion traps enemies in a space where the user's technique always hits. Sorcerers and curses are ranked from Grade 4 to Special Grade. Toji Fushiguro has no cursed energy at all (Heavenly Restriction) in exchange for superhuman body strength.
